source.candidate: one flattened dynamic-feature update plus a bounded immutable CPU goal-plane template

canonical_throughput.method: Two adjacent unprofiled runs per implementation on the same host; arithmetic means summarize the recorded runs.

detailed_source_observer.note: Observer overhead makes this diagnostic; only the two unprofiled canonical runs per implementation support the throughput claim.

equivalence.differential_test_scope: Complete version-1 float32 byte buffers on deterministic legal trajectories for 1x1, 2x3, 10x10, and 24x24 boards; cached-template results additionally prove independent returned storage.

representative_batch_microbenchmark.method: Nine samples of 1000 calls after 100 warmups; median for eight deterministic 10x10 legal-play positions at plies 8 through 64, seed 2401, on CPU. Both implementations ran in the same process.

rejected_approaches.implementation: one flattened dynamic-feature update without a static goal-plane template
rejected_approaches.reason_rejected: It removed repeated advanced-index conversion but still rebuilt and populated four identical goal borders for every batch; the immutable spatial template measured 117.99 us in the same exploratory nine-sample, 5000-call test.

rejected_approaches.implementation: replace owner-to-channel lookup tables with Player identity branches
rejected_approaches.reason_rejected: Identity branches were 12.78% slower in the isolated deterministic index-construction trial.

rejected_approaches.implementation: cache a complete batch-sized static tensor instead of one spatial template
rejected_approaches.reason_rejected: The 0.70 us allocation difference did not justify retaining a separate full tensor for every batch-size and board-size combination; the spatial template bounds cached storage independently of batch size.

rejected_approaches.implementation: reuse mutable output tensors across evaluate_batch calls
rejected_approaches.reason_rejected: Returned encodings are caller-owned and inference batches can overlap. Pooling mutable output storage would risk cross-request aliasing or require synchronization whose end-to-end value was not established.
